title: G4 LENS CARNIVAL (Soca × Steelpan × UK Funky) [128]
style: Caribbean soca meets Trinidadian steelpan and UK funky, 128 BPM, instrumental with chipmunk-pitched vocal chops only (no lead vocal, no rap), trilingual chop weave English Caribbean + Spanish Caribbean + te reo Maori, bright steelpan melody runs, classic soca kick-snare pattern, UK funky broken percussion grooves, conga and timbale fills, deep sub bass with slides, brass stabs, sharp whistle hooks, female chops pitched +6 and male chops at -3, carnival-streets-daytime exuberance, sidechain pumping pads to kick, festival mainstage 2026 production, no profanity, no real-artist references
lyrics:
[Intro]
(steelpan melody, distant whistle, conga roll)
(G4... LENS... car... ni... val...)
(wave... wave... wave...)
(haka... pa... haka... pa...)

[Build]
(soca kick locks in, brass stabs swell, sub slides up)
G4! LENS! CAR — NI — VAL!
WAVE! WAVE! WAVE!
FI — ESTA! FI — ESTA!
KEEL — CLEAR — GO!
(whistle roll, steelpan climb)

[Drop 1]
(full soca pocket, UK funky percussion, steelpan lead)
CAR — NI — VAL!
WAVE — FLAG!
FEEL — JOY!
LENS — ON!
(chop stack +7) jump-jump-vamos-vamos / āe-āe-jump-jump
THREE — THREE — SIX!
G4 — LENS — ON!

[Verse]
(steelpan solo phrase, timbale fills, chops trade)
(wha gwan?) (¿qué lo qué?) (kei te aha?)
(jam!) (¡dale!) (haere!)
(carnival!) (¡carnaval!) (haka!)
McIVOR HOLDS THE FLAG —
ZYNCONTEXT HOLDS THE LOOP —
SONGPAL HEARS THE CALL —
FINICH — NOT — FINISH!

[Breakdown]
(strip to steelpan + soft pad alone, no kick)
(whispered) g4... lens... carnival...
(soft) wave... wave...
(soft) haka pa... haka pa...
(piano lifts, soft chop)
KEEL... CLEAR...
THREE... THREE... SIX...
(whistle roll builds, soca kick returns)

[Drop 2]
(double-time soca, full carnival stack peak, brass doubled)
G4 — LENS — CAR — NI — VAL! (jump jump jump!)
WAVE — FLAG! (¡dale! haere!)
FEEL — JOY! (āe āe āe!)
KEEL — TAKE — OVER!
G4 — LENS — LOCKED!
THREE — THREE — SIX!
FINICH — NOT — FINISH!

[Outro]
(soca fades, steelpan resolves, whistle echoes)
(g4... lens... carnival...)
(wave... fiesta...)
(KEEL... CLEAR...)
(steelpan motif fades to silence)
